body.statement: Using \(\mathsf{FrontierHandle}\), determine a positive scale \(f_2(n)\), constants \(0<c_2\le C_2<\infty\), and an onset \(n_0\) such that the padded windmills satisfy \(G_n^{\star}\in\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\), \(\operatorname{HTCcert}(G_n^{\star})=\operatorname{ICcert}(G_n^{\star})=\operatorname{ACcert}(G_n^{\star})=0\), and, for every \(n\ge n_0\), \[c_2f_2(n)\le ID_{G_n^{\star}}\le D_2(n)\le C_2f_2(n).\] Determine the finite exceptional values \(D_2(1),\ldots,D_2(n_0-1)\) by exact closure. The upper direction must show that a proper closure at degree \(\lceil C_2f_2(n)\rceil\) forces failure of generic birationality. For the lower direction, for every \(S\in\operatorname{Reach}_{\lfloor c_2f_2(n)\rfloor-1}(G_n^{\star})\) with \(\zeta_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\notin S\), prove \(\mathfrak H_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor,\lfloor c_2f_2(n)\rfloor-1}(S)\ne0\). This exact Hilbert-rank obstruction must survive every permitted earlier adjunction of structural or disturbance coordinates and hence keep \(\zeta_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\) outside \(\operatorname{Cl}_{\lfloor c_2f_2(n)\rfloor-1}(G_n^{\star})\). Solving both directions strictly strengthens the prespecified-degree guarantee of Hollering, Misra, and Sturma on the full class \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\), rather than reproving their bounded subclass results.
body.justification: The matching scale is the first graph-uniform calibration of minimum recursive formula degree at the first non-tree indegree.
body.gap: Hollering, Misra, and Sturma require an external degree input for the full rationally identifiable class. Their Propositions 7.2 and 7.3 give \(2s_{\mathrm{HMS}}+1\) for the half-trek and instrumental-cutset subclasses, while Proposition 7.4 gives \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^4+2s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^3+s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^2\) for auxiliary cutsets; at \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}=2\) these are \(5\), \(5\), and \(36\). Tree identification controls scalar Möbius cycles, and inverse-map regularity theory does not align its degree with recursive SEM certificates.
body.consumer: The degree-bounded symbolic algorithm receives a necessary-order stopping threshold rather than an analyst-chosen promise parameter.
